title: The Unicorn Forest
subtitle: The witch in the shining bubble
opening: The unicorn paths are dark. Deep between the trees, a huge bubble shines with little hoofprints inside.
ending: The unicorns dance beneath the trees. Willow clears the rockslide with her wand. Beyond it rises Fire Mountain, and all the clues finally point to one place.
not_yet: That place is resting. Follow the glowing landmark on your quest card.

steps.title: A voice from the bubble
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow
steps.clue: Liza! It is Willow. My bubble kept the unicorns safe when the forest was zapped. I cannot leave it yet. Wake our three paths, then help me open the bubble gently.

steps.title: The sleeping paths
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow
steps.clue: Find a Rainbow Thread at the Moon Crystal, a Root Key at the Elder Tree, and a Wind Ribbon at the Treasure Chest. These will stitch our paths together.

steps.title: The Wayweave spell
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow
steps.clue: Thread, key, and ribbon: let lost paths meet. Wayweave opens a safe road through tangled places. Follow its green light from landmark to landmark.

steps.title: Stitch the forest together
steps.clue: Carry Wayweave from the Elder Tree to the Moon Crystal, then to the Treasure Chest. The three paths will meet beneath my bubble.
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow

steps.title: One small unicorn
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow
steps.clue: The paths are bright! But a little unicorn is afraid to step outside. A loud pop would frighten her. Let us open the bubble with a soft song instead.

steps.title: A song without a sound
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow
steps.clue: Collect a Star Petal at the Moon Crystal, a Humming Seed at the Elder Tree, and a Tiny Music Box at the Treasure Chest. Bring the song back to the TV.

steps.title: The Starcall spell
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow
steps.clue: A petal, a seed, a music box: wake the courage in a small heart. Starcall carries a friend’s voice across the dark. Listen; every unicorn knows your name.

steps.title: Open the shining bubble
steps.clue: Sing with your wand: Treasure Chest, Elder Tree, Moon Crystal. Each wave loosens one ribbon of the bubble. No popping. Just a gentle opening.
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow

steps.title: Willow steps into the light
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow
steps.clue: Here they come! One, two, all our unicorns. Thank you, Liza. I saw the same black vine in the pools, the caves, and my forest. It follows the Heart Crystal.

steps.title: Clear the rockslide
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow
steps.clue: Go to the Elder Tree. Cast Wayweave, and I will lift the stones with you. There is our road up Fire Mountain!

steps.title: The mark on every vine
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow
steps.clue: Visit the Moon Crystal. Use Truthlight on a black leaf. A tiny heart shape appears. Remember that mark; it is the clue we have been missing.

steps.title: All our roads meet
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow
steps.clue: Take your spells up the mountain. Luma, Pip, Queen Orielle, and I will be with you in spirit. Find Emberwing. Find out what her egg really needs.
